maintenance: PowerEvolve product fork: structured argument architecture, Markdown heading preservation, and explicit user revision requests; original writing and review rules retained.

changes.summary: Align active Skill metadata with the cloud-only catalog release; preserve all predecessor distribution bytes.
Publish a cloud-only successor for the official DSH migration; preserve installed predecessor bytes and remove Device execution guidance from active instructions.

Reject modern bilingual abstract drafts with fewer or more than three English paragraphs during actual apply; retain rejected versions and require repaired new-version validation before confirmation. Preserve historical confirmation behavior.

Bind new reference requests to contract 2 and top-level internet_access/items; check local source bytes with an explicit caller-provided root during apply and confirm, preserve captured legacy external-only plans, reject placeholder HTTP, and forward the same reference plan to chapter and formal review consumers.

Publish Cloud and Desktop targets; synchronize workflow JSON through an atomic same-directory replacement and report uncertain post-replacement commits; require exact integer page coverage for current-version Word acceptance.
Add the paired English/Chinese chapter confirmation fixture README and consistency record; retain captured inputs, historical versions and workflow behavior.

Preserve numbered figure/table caption separators and image alt prefixes in the actual final report assembly normalizer and its CLI, retaining existing heading protection and cleanup within titles and prose.

Accept the existing nested chapter mapping, reject invalid responses before consuming the pending request, avoid duplicate foundation/conclusion targets, and repair previously applied invalid drafts through a fresh child request and append-only version before explicit confirmation.
Preserve ATX heading markers, numbering and separators during deterministic Markdown cleaning so the existing heading validator and final Word source parser keep reading confirmed headings.

Add version-bound, idempotent explicit user revision requests at unconfirmed approval points; preserve historical artifacts and formal reviews, route feedback separately to existing generator actions, require new output files and repeat current-version validation/review.

Allow one explicit user-authorized revision of the current unconfirmed chapter after a recorded, latest-review-bound chapter revision limit; preserve failure counters and history, keep other blocked/failed reasons rejected, and require all original gates and new-version formal review before confirmation.
